changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwprescriptioninstruction AS SELECT pi.id, pi.category, pi.dose, pi.unit, pi.rout, pi.frequency FROM public.prescription_instruction pi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwprescriptioninstruction TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwprescriptioninstruction FROM report_user;
